main_text.p: בחן Ch. Probare, Explorare. Pah. Partic. מבחנן Probant. Psal.11.4. Aphel Futur. אבחן Probabo, Eccles.2.1.

בחר Ch. Elegit, Selegit, delegit: Probavit, explooravit: Syr. est Animadvertere, perspicere, cernere. Ithpeh. אתבחר Ch. Eligi, Seligi: Probari, explorari, Genes.42.15.16. Syr. ܒܚܝܪ Cum probatus fuerit, Jaco.1.12. Fut. ex priori significatione, ܢܒܚܘܢ Et tum perspicacitas erit tibi, Tum dispicies, Matth.7.5.
בחירא, בחיר Ch. & Syr. Electus, Selectus, חמר בחיר Vinum selectum, Num.28.7. in T. Hierof. Plur. בחירין. Foeminin. בחירתא, בחירתא Electa, Cantic.8.2. 1.Pet.2.6. Plur. בחירן.

בחש Inquirere, investigare, scrutari, Infin. למבחוש Ad inquirendum, Genes.39.11. in Jonath. Item Tractare: Miscere, commiscere, Germ. Rühren/ ובחשן בדמא Et commiscebant sanguinem, tractabant, nescilicet coagularetur, Esth.1.14. verf. והקרוב.
בטח Fidit, Confidit, speravit. Ithpeh. Part. את מתבטח Tu confidens es, Jerem.12.5. Ex Aphel ראבטחתני Qui sperare fecisti me, Ruth.2.13.
אבטיחיא Ch. Pepones, Num.11.5. Hebr. אבטיחים. Aben Esra scribit esse notam vocem ex lingua Kedarena, h.e. Arabica. Quod ita esse, apparet ex Translatione

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed approximately; several Syriac and pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Right page is a show-through of the following page and is omitted.
